driverContract.outputFieldSet: Derived from output.fields; the reporter rejects extra, missing, or renamed output keys.

purpose: Prepare current-rules standard and consensus full-stock capture and cached timing with absolute wall-clock samples and within-process relative ratios.

sourceInputAccounting.qualification: These are source roster and recorded-prefix counts; unknown tails are not observed timing work.

referenceDeduplication: The 2026 standard trxhzt row carries both current-standard-trxhzt and annual-standard-trxhzt-2026 only after exact transaction, ordered UTXO, input-boundary, and flag equality. Annual standard rows added to either campaign remain official annual-standard rows with their pack flags and domain; campaign membership is orthogonal to their effective annual mode.

rowSchema.fieldRules: The input oracle is consumed by the driver and is never re-emitted. Capture output uses the exact driver-contract output.fields set; timing output adds launcher-owned process. The in-memory corpus retains roles as a list for dual-role deduplication; the driver receives one selected role label per row. Policy rows use oracle=[], vectors=[], attempts=0, accepted=null, first_script_error=null, timing_performed=false, and cached_verify_nanoseconds=null. Capture setup/timing fields are null; timing setup fields are nonnegative integers except pre/post controls are null for pre-script policy rows. Script rows use two equal full vectors and source-derived input counts.

schedules.orders: Six counterbalanced pack orders/directions; each process contains each campaign identity exactly once. Standard and consensus are separate campaigns.

requirements: Run every input for every current script row in both passes.
Preserve and verify the existing stop-first prefix, first error, acceptance, and policy classification.
Do not fill unknown current tails from annual rows, another mode, or a uniform assumption.
Emit full pre/post vectors while retaining the recorded input scope; independent review later binds full-observed-all-input timing inputs.
captureGate.oracleScope: The capture input scope is recorded-stop-first-prefix unless the source oracle is already full; policy rows also use recorded-stop-first-prefix. Output echoes that scope until independent review binds full-observed-all-input.
captureGate.untimedControlPasses: 2 for script rows; 0 for pre-script policy rows

timingGate.requires: An independently reviewed capture receipt for every script row with two matching full-input vectors.
rejects: Policy pre-rejections treated as VerifyScript work
timingGate.timedBoundary: The cached VerifyScript all-input loop, including its first-failure bookkeeping, is timed; decode, cache, coins, checker precompute, pre-control, post-control, and process wall are reported separately.
timingGate.aggregation: Take the three evaluation values within each process before forming ratios; retain all six process values and ranges.
timingGate.oracleScope: full-observed-all-input for script and policy output rows after the independent capture review gate

policyRows: Current-standard pre-script policy rows have zero script attempts, null script acceptance, null cached timing and no script oracle. They remain in the roster and are not performance samples. Their input and capture oracle_scope is recorded-stop-first-prefix; a reviewed timing output uses full-observed-all-input and keeps policy_preflight_nanoseconds separate.
qualification: This is a source-only corpus and reporting contract. It contains no current-mode full-tail capture, native timing, VM-memory measurement, opcost result, or schedule optimality claim.
